findings.message: The required default plan=None and removal of runtime plan reads cause live tickets with valid Plan contract citations to fail parsing. Keeping those tickets functional requires changing the Plan contract grammar or continuing to supply the plan, both prohibited by the ticket.
findings.paved_road: Remove or relax Plan contract validation in a prerequisite, or revise this ticket to permit that grammar change and define the intended validation behavior.
